notes: Build and hire pads are now flat markings on the ground, in the same light or dark shade as the guide arrows, so they read in day, dusk, night and storm.
A pad hidden behind a tall building now shows faintly through it instead of disappearing.
KILN now floats closer beside you, the same size in every level, and it shows up beside you when it teaches something new.
Level 3: after Sela's first sale, you build the camp wall yourself. The nights are long, and the road may bring raiders.
Sela's buggy drives into camp and parks by the kiosk, headlights on.
The crash site shows all five stasis pods.
